title: championella fauriei
intro: Championella fauriei, commonly known as Asian jasmine or star jasmine, is a flowering vine native to East Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Championella fauriei include its anxiolytic, sedative, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
